mode_lerp.desc: States blend smoothly instead of hard-switching. Each mode = full parameter set.
mode_lerp.mechanic: modeLerp goes 0->1 on switch; every param lerps toward its mode target each frame: v += (target-v)*k*dt

agent_use: Planet temperaments and agent states blend (e.g. Tempest calm<->storm) instead of snapping. Auto-cycle on long idle like the 45s screensaver.
skip: Three.js scene itself (CDN three.js, decorative); keep the lerp discipline only.
